label: Oviedo-Cáceres 2023
setting: clinical practice guideline development (Colombian health system); no patient sample analysed
recruitment: not applicable: evidence-based guideline (GRADE, AGREE II, QUADAS, AMSTAR) with a group of 22 people with low vision and relatives rating outcomes (p3); searches Nov-Dec 2019 updated Jun-Jul 2020 (p3-4)
notes: no primary data and no accuracy analysis; recommends NEI VFQ for early assessment and follow-up of vision-related quality of life in patients >18 years with low vision (p5 Table 1; p10); published Rev Mex Oftalmol 2022;96(5) (journal header p4) although the screening record gives 2023; low vision defined as best corrected VA worse than 20/60 but equal to or better than 20/400 in the best eye or visual field <20 degrees in the best eye (p6)
